continuation_surface_label: Example load-more / infinite-scroll posture for official voter-information result sets
delivery_role_note: Bounded continuation surface for official voter-information routes that extend the same answer-bearing set after initial page load.
set_size_visibility_note: The route states whether the total number of results is known, unknown, or still being refined after filters or live availability changes.
item_identity_and_position_note: Result cards keep stable headings and bounded position meaning so a voter can re-find the same office or location after more items load.
loading_status_announcement_note: A polite status message announces when more official results are loading, when they finish loading, and when continuation fails or reaches the end of the set.
focus_after_continuation_note: After activating Load more, focus behavior remains logical and reviewable: the control stays coherent until completion and the newly extended set can be traversed without a focus hunt.
end_of_set_or_retry_note: The route distinguishes among end of set, temporary retrieval failure, and unknown remaining size instead of silently stopping.
refindability_after_return_note: The office reviewed how a previously seen controlling item can be re-found after additional loading or a later revisit to the same route.
mobile_or_compact_variant_note: Compact/mobile variants preserve the continuation control, status text, and item identity cues rather than collapsing them into silent autoload behavior.
help_or_overview_escape_note: Where continuation alone may not resolve the case, a visible overview/help lane remains available instead of forcing brute-force scrolling through the full set.
